state.review: Re-evaluate selected choreography rows using only their material source/target facts and proof rules. A dispatcher is not proof of target commitment. Do not require child-stage proofs where the selected row has no intermediate stage; judge the row kind and its actual conditions.

ownerFacts.identity: Tenant / existing EvidenceStreams artifact key / ArtifactId, with immutable source identity and verified content binding. ArtifactId identifies registration; selected mutations use CommandId. Download grants use the separately adopted artifact-qualified receiving identity.
ownerFacts.invariant: Immutable content remains unavailable until clean inspection; malware alone can be released with attributed clean rescan; secret/invalid rejection is final.
ownerFacts.boundaryRationale: Inspection and quarantine release share availability decision. Download authorization needs an admission proof against that decision but every historical download need not extend artifact lifecycle stream.

ownerFacts.identity: UUIDv5 namespace ArtifactId, UTF8 artifact-download-grant:v1:{canonical TenantId}:{canonical CommandId}. Receiving root additionally verifies exact artifact/command/original-actor tuple. No generic operation lookup.
ownerFacts.invariant: One exact receiving grant owns the authenticated encrypted original artifact ticket/result after EvidenceArtifact first admitted and pinned availability with frozen202. Complete required held source uses and exact issue DecisionAt precede native issued-v2; cancellation fences delayed issuance and terminal proofs settle all uses. Original expiry never renews under the same root identity. Existing artifact-issued v1 decoder remains read-only compatibility.

selectedContract.identifiedRequestRule: IIdentifiedRequest.RequestId maps to the caller CommandId; reject missing/empty/malformed identity, never substitute context trace/request id.

http.body: existing authored purpose and optional complete consultant scope; all route identities canonical and cannot be replaced by query/body identity

selectedContract.logicalOperationId: caller CommandId scoped to first owner
currentGuardsPreserved: Personal HTTP invocation only; no system actor; Bdgrz user maps to tenant member actor with display.
Ordinary caller: current exact SharedResource artifact EvidenceArtifactRead permission via IAccessGrantScopePermissionAuthorizer.

Consultant scope is all-or-none: nonempty ProgramId + AdvisorHandoffId + supported evidence-artifact SelectedSource matching ArtifactId, active shared-source authorization and sourceVersions.RequireCurrentAsync.

Capture actual canonical registration/current metadata and complete source prefix; artifact Available with nonfuture availability instant; content hash/length exact; physical source position must fit signed long.
IssueDeliveryAsync only for actual tenant/hash/length; absolute HTTPS or urn:bdgrz:artifact-delivery: URI; expiry > now and <= now + five minutes.
Recheck access and canonical metadata after ticket preparation; append checks unchanged physical position, Available state, hash and length.
RecordDownload validates exact business revision, request UUID, member kind/UUID/display<=200, IssuedAt>=RegisteredAt, canonical purpose and content tuple.
selectedContract.admissionAuthorization: Current personal Bdgrz HTTP caller and exact artifact read right before native replay. Preserve ordinary current scoped permission path and all-or-none consultant program/handoff/selected-source authorization. Exact retry compares same original actor identity and normalized authored terms.
selectedContract.frozenIntent: Exact canonical original request, root/actor/first-owner provenance, derived GrantId, actual content hash/length/head and available-inspection source/cut, complete optional handoff + explicit handling-policy requirements, maximum delivery lifetime. Freeze actual immutable default policy when selected; no absent-source surrogate.

atomicLocalAvailabilityRole.authority: The single committed EvidenceArtifactDownloadRequested fact simultaneously records admission and installs its exact local availability reservation/fence.
atomicLocalAvailabilityRole.predicate: Pin this artifact-owned available inspected content/head and exact generation for this admitted root through actual receiving issue or cancellation. Any artifact-owned mutation that would invalidate it must honor the reservation.
atomicLocalAvailabilityRole.identity: Exact first-owner artifact + root CommandId + receiving derived grant + purpose/generation; no global command uniqueness assumption.
atomicLocalAvailabilityRole.proofTiming: Before append, only prove actual already-saved predecessor/content sources. Never construct a proof of the future Requested fact. After append, derive and verify actual saved Requested source/metadata and local reservation authority; that fact proves the availability grant for foreign issue.
atomicLocalAvailabilityRole.bounds: Retain every active reservation legitimately needed for current authority; no arbitrary cap. Closed history/fences may be externalized only with verified immutable exact-cut authority.
atomicLocalAvailabilityRole.externalBoundary: This local hold does not claim an atomic transaction with foreign owners or physical content storage. Issue still proves actual stored content/URI and bounded lifetime; unavailable dependencies remain transient. No invented cross-owner permit or absence proof.

selectedContract.originalResponse: Freeze the exact standard 202 OperationAcceptedResponse(CommandId, artifact-scoped status URL, original AcceptedAt) on first acceptance. Later receiving issuance never replaces or reconstructs that root first response.
selectedContract.replayAndFailure: Current public authorization first; exact native original202 returns only for fully bound original intent/actor. Equal winner and unknown append recover actual committed acceptance; requested cancellation passes through. Availability/source conflict or corruption does not silently become cancellation without the selected proof.
selectedContract.sourceEntry: current-authorized personal HTTP command, not an event subscription
selectedContract.requestContract: IRequest<OperationAcceptedResponse>, IIdentifiedRequest; existing personal artifact mutation authorization retained

decisionBasis.authority: Names, ownership, invariants and causal proof requirements are selected here. Native field/wire migration and runtime implementation remain separately verifiable work.

selectedContract.identityRule: All identity comes from the canonical scoped path; misleading query identities cannot override it. Derive exact receiving GrantId locally, never scan a generic operation registry.
selectedContract.authorization: Current personal HTTP actor must match the original admitted personal actor identity AND still possess current exact artifact read rights/required current consultant handoff scope. Current rights alone do not authorize another actor original ticket; original actor alone does not bypass current rights. Use existing denial/concealment behavior for unauthorized or mismatched owner/root.
selectedContract.response: closed Pending / issued / canceled union, bound to same tenant/artifact/root command/GrantId

variants.authority: actual verified Requested admission, with no receiving terminal outcome yet provable
variants.contents: scoped identity + original accepted state/time; no ticket or guessed cancellation

variants.authority: actual receiving issued v2 plus authenticated encrypted original ticket/result and matching root/actor/proofs
variants.contents: same stored original ticket location and expiry, never regenerated or extended; return original expired ticket unchanged when authorized

variants.authority: actual receiving cancellation/fence bound to same root and generation
variants.contents: scoped canceled status and selected safe bounded failure code; no ticket

selectedContract.unavailableRule: Source/protected-result unavailability is transient, never guessed pending/canceled/absent authority; malformed/corrupt proof fails closed. A legitimately missing admitted root is not found.
selectedContract.noRenewal: Read and exact write retry cannot mint/refresh a ticket. A new authorized command is required for a new delivery.
selectedContract.legacyRule: Old artifact-issued v1 has no persisted native admission/encrypted ticket. Preserve historical metadata decoder/read behavior, but never fabricate a native grant or original ticket for it.
selectedContract.logicalPrerequisiteRule: Verified Requested admission AND the actual selected state: pending with no terminal yet provable, receiving issuedv2, or cancellation. These event variants are not an all-events requirement.
